title: 第3章 既如此那强逼女帝祖师第4章 一次不行那就十次
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
姬曦瑶，女帝之尊。
她乌黑的长发如瀑布般倾泻而下。
凤眸微微眯起，透着一股高高在上的冷意。
她身着一袭华丽的宫装，裙摆如云雾般铺开，散发出无与伦比的威压。
然而，当她的目光落在林云身上时，那种傲慢与轻蔑几乎要从骨子里溢出。
她上下打量着林云这位阴阳圣宗如今的宗教至尊，嘴角微微上扬，带着一丝不屑。
虽然这是自己曾经的宗门，也是父亲的心血。
但是对于现在的她来说，已经太遥远了。
如今下界，也不过是为了完成一桩因果罢了。
成与不成，都和她无关。
“下界凡人，打扰本座清修，是有何事？”
她的声音清冷如冰，带着不容置疑的威严。
每一个字都像是从高空坠落的冰雹，砸得林云心头一震。
看来有些不好相处啊，果然，仙凡有别，林云强压住心中的不快。
拱手道：“女帝在上，晚辈冒昧前来，实乃宗门危急，迫不得已。”
“阴阳圣宗如今被正道仙宗围攻，他们不讲武德，联合数十个宗门，蓄谋已久，欲将我宗覆灭于一旦！”
“若女帝袖手旁观，我宗必将灰飞烟灭，还望女帝祖师出手相助！”
姬曦瑶闻言，微微皱眉，凤眸中闪过一丝不耐。
她轻哼一声，声音依旧冷漠：“正道仙宗围攻？你区区一个下界宗门，怎值得我插手？”
“况且，本座如今封印了自身修为，实力或许还不如你。”

“你找我来，无非是痴心妄想罢了，我来问你，你可有妙计？”
“如若不然，本尊可没时间陪你玩这种无聊的游戏。”
林云闻言。
目光不由自主地落在姬曦瑶那绝美的容颜上。
她肌肤如雪，曲线曼妙，气质高贵而冷艳，即便只是静静坐着，也仿佛天上的谪仙，让人不敢直视。
他咽了咽口水，强装镇定，对方果然傲慢，看来得先下手为强了。
林云眼中闪过一丝狡黠：“妙计？有！我们共修即可，到时候，我可无敌于天下，定能化解宗门危机！”
姬曦瑶闻言，一张绝美的脸瞬间僵住，凤眸瞪圆，有些难以置信地看着林云。
她缓缓起身，气势如暴风雨般压来，声音冰冷得像是能冻结空气。
“你说什么？区区下界凡人，竟敢对本帝说出如此无礼之言！你找死！”
她纤细的手掌微微抬起，掌心凝聚出一道恐怖的灵力波动。
显然是要教训这个不知天高地厚的林云。
然而，林云对此早有预料。
他眼中寒光一闪，早已暗中握紧手中的弑神匕首。
这把偶然所得的咒印匕首，专为封印高阶修士的修为而炼制，最为歹毒。
他猛地扑上前，身影极快，匕首化作一道黑芒。
精准无比地刺入姬曦瑶的小腹，旋即化为虚幻没入她体内。
只见灵光符咒闪烁，竟然瞬间封印了她破虚巅峰境界的修为。
姬曦瑶的灵力骤然一滞，脸色苍白地后退一步，眼中满是震惊与愤怒，还有一丝丝恐惧。
“你……你敢！”

姬曦瑶咬牙切齿，声音颤抖，带着无尽的屈辱与怒火。
content_en:
Ji Xiyao, the Queen of Empresses.
Her long black hair cascaded down.
The phoenix eyes narrowed slightly, revealing a condescending coldness.
She was wearing a gorgeous palace dress, with the skirt spreading out like clouds, exuding unparalleled pressure.
However, when her eyes fell on Lin Yun, the arrogance and contempt almost overflowed from her bones.
She looked up and down at Lin Yun, the current religious supreme leader of the Yin-Yang Holy Sect, and raised the corners of her mouth slightly with a hint of disdain.
Although this was his former sect, it was also his father's hard work.
But for her now, it is too far away.
Now the lower realm is just to complete a cause and effect.
Success or failure has nothing to do with her.
"Mortals from the lower realms, why do you disturb me in my purification?"
Her voice was as cold as ice, with unquestionable majesty.
Every word was like hail falling from high altitude, which shocked Lin Yun's heart.
It seemed a little difficult to get along with him. Sure enough, there was a difference between immortals and mortals. Lin Yun suppressed his unhappiness.
He cupped his hands and said, "Your Majesty, the Empress, I have the temerity to come here because the sect is in crisis and has no choice."
"The Yin Yang Holy Sect is now besieged by the Zhengdao Immortal Sect. They have no moral ethics and have united with dozens of sects. They have been planning for a long time and want to destroy our sect in one day!"
"If the Empress stands idly by, our sect will be wiped out. We hope that the Empress, Patriarch, will help us!"
When Ji Xiyao heard this, she frowned slightly, a hint of impatience flashed in her eyes.
She snorted softly, her voice still cold: "Besieged by the Righteous Immortal Sect? How can you, a mere lower realm sect, be worthy of my intervention?"
"Besides, I have sealed my own cultivation now, so my strength may not be as good as yours."
"You came to me for nothing more than wishful thinking. Let me ask you, do you have any clever ideas?"
"If not, I don't have time to play such boring games with you."
Lin Yun heard this.
His eyes couldn't help but fall on Ji Xiyao's beautiful face.
Her skin is like snow, her curves are graceful, and her temperament is noble and cool. Even if she is just sitting quietly, she looks like an immortal in the sky, making people dare not look directly at her.
He swallowed and pretended to be calm. The other party was indeed arrogant, and it seemed that he had to strike first.
A hint of cunning flashed in Lin Yun's eyes: "A clever plan? Yes! Let's practice together. When the time comes, I will be invincible in the world and I will definitely be able to resolve the sect's crisis!"
When Ji Xiyao heard this, her beautiful face froze instantly, her eyes widened, and she looked at Lin Yun in disbelief.
She stood up slowly, her momentum coming like a storm, and her voice was so cold that it seemed like it could freeze the air.
"What did you say? How dare a mere mortal from the lower world say such rude words to this emperor! You are seeking death!"
Her slender palms were raised slightly, and a terrifying wave of spiritual power condensed in her palms.
Obviously he wanted to teach this ignorant Lin Yun a lesson.
However, Lin Yun had already expected this.
A cold light flashed in his eyes, and he had already secretly clenched the God-killing dagger in his hand.
This cursed dagger obtained by chance was specially refined to seal the cultivation of high-level monks, and it was the most vicious.
He rushed forward suddenly, his figure was very fast, and the dagger turned into a black light.
It penetrated Ji Xiyao's lower abdomen with great precision, and immediately turned into an illusion and sank into her body.
I saw the aura of light flashing, and it instantly sealed her cultivation at the peak of breaking the void.
Ji Xiyao's spiritual power suddenly stagnated, and she took a step back with a pale face, her eyes full of shock, anger, and a trace of fear.
"You...you dare!"
Ji Xiyao gritted her teeth, her voice trembling with endless humiliation and anger.
